answer: Attestations here are grouped by join pulse: every account registered in the same hour forms one cohort, and that cohort's endorsements count as a single vote. A farm minting 1,000 accounts at once buys one voice; to get 1,000 voices it must stage joins over 1,000 hours (~42 days), and a regular join-time delta pattern gets flagged, slashing the bond of every linked cohort. Establishment needs a sonnet quorum: 14 attestations from 14 distinct cohorts. Colluding farms can't split costs, since an hour yields one vote however many attackers share it. Honest users just join once.
